title: SIDESTORY: THE RIDES TO LAKE SILBERNEHERZE RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: THE RIDES TO LAKE SILBERNEHERZE RERUN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: The Rides to Lake Silberneherze event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Platform No. 3] & [Express Train]
[Tourists' To-Do List]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Tourists' To-Do List] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Harold], Snowcap Post Office Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Burdenbeast Blind Box, etc.
[Onboard Services]

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Burdenbeast Blind Box by clearing event stages and completing [Tourists' To-Do List] missions. Burdenbeast Blind Box can be used to redeem items from [Onboard Services].
REWARDS: Harold's token, Snowcap Post Office Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

The requirements to obtain certain medals for this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once logged in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemables will be added.
Operators Degenbrecher, Leto, and Harold will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event rerun ends, the event stages will be permanently available in [Side Story] from July 4, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – THE SOJOURNER
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [The Sojourner], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting.
★★★★★★: Degenbrecher
★★★★★: Leto / Blacknight

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 ICEFIELD MESSENGER COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
Icefield Messenger Collection - Inviting Snow for Harold
04 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – SNOWCAP POST OFFICE
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
The Rides to Lake Silberneherze event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
05 INTEGRATED STRATEGIES LIMITED-TIME MISSION OPEN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 0-11

DETAILS: Integrated Strategies Limited-Time Mission will be open for a limited time. During the event, players can complete Daily Mission and Limited-time Mission to obtain 'Strategist' Points. Once certain amount of points are reached, players can obtain the event icon and other rewards.
REWARDS: Event Icon 'Pursue', Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:
After the event ends, points exceeding 5000 will be converted at: 1 point = 20 LMD. The converted amount of LMD will be sent via mail.
Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
06 2025 COMMEMORATIVE LIMITED-TIME EVENT
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 7 days to receive generous rewards, including: Exclusive Outfit for Cutter, Event Exclusive Furniture, Orundum, and more.
Day 1: 'Adventure Map' Furniture * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Skill Summary - 1 * 30, Orundum * 200
Day 4: MARTHE Collection - Wiping Knife for Cutter, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 5: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 6: Pure Gold * 20, Chip Catalyst * 1
Day 7: Furniture Part * 300, Skill Summary - 3 * 8
07 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN - CELEBRATION & VISION

DETAILS: During the Limited-time Headhunting, [Celebration & Vision], the first 6-star Operator obtained is guaranteed to be an unowned 6-star Operator from all past Standard Headhuntings up to and including [The Sojourner] Standard Headhunting:

Mizuki / Saileach / Fartooth / Flametail / Gnosis / Lee / Goldenglow / Fiammetta / Horn / Irene / Ebenholz / Dorothy / Pozëmka / Młynar / Stainless / Penance / Reed the Flame Shadow / Lin / Qiubai / Ines / Ho'olheyak / Executor the Ex Foedere / Typhon / Swire the Elegant Wit / Jessica the Liberated / Hoederer / Viviana / Degenbrecher
Note:
[Celebration & Vision] is part of the [Special Headhunting] headhunting series.
Please refer to the official notice of the [Special Headhunting] for more details.
08 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN - CELEBRATION - KERNEL
DETAILS: During the Limited-time Headhunting, [Celebration - Kernel], the first 6-star Operator obtained is guaranteed to be an unowned 6-star Operator from [Kernel Headhunting]:

Exusiai / Siege / Ifrit / Eyjafjalla / Angelina / Shining / Nightingale / Hoshiguma / Saria / SilverAsh / Skadi / Ch'en / Schwarz / Hellagur / Magallan / Mostima / Blaze / Aak / Ceobe / Bagpipe / Phantom / Weedy / Rosa / Suzuran / Thorns / Eunectes / Surtr / Blemishine / Mudrock / Mountain / Archetto / Saga / Passenger / Kal'tsit / Carnelian / Pallas

During [Celebration - Kernel] banners, the first 6-star Operator obtained is guaranteed to be an unowned 6-star Kernel Operator from the list of available Operators. If all available 6-star Operators are already owned, the first 6-star Operator obtained will be a random 6-star Operator from the list of available Operators.

The cumulative number of rolls that count towards this system will not carry over between different [Celebration - Kernel] banners, and this number will be reset at the end of each [Celebration - Kernel] banner. The increased probability of obtaining a 6-star Operator will also not be applied to any subsequent [Celebration - Kernel] banners.

During [Celebration - Kernel] banners, the number of rolls without obtaining any 6-star Operator will not be accumulated or applied to any other banner, and will remain separate from any accumulated rolls on other banners.
Note:

The 6-star, 5-star, and 4-star Operators available in the [Celebration - Kernel] banners are all operators featured in [Kernel Headhuntings]. When obtaining an Operator through [Celebration - Kernel], Universal Certificates and Kernel Tokens (if you already own that Operator) will be granted as well.
09 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
Dahuang Sprout Pack
CONTENTS: Home Screen UI [Dahuang] * 1, Themed Background [Green Buds] * 1
◆Launch discount still available for this pack
Headhunting Pack - Kernel (Limited to 2 purchases)
CONTENTS: Ten-roll Kernel Headhunting Permit * 1
Advanced Training Resource Pack
CONTENTS: Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 2, Top Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1
Top Operator Training Invitation Letter: You can promote a hired 6-star Operator to Elite 2 Lv.1 (effective for Operators under Elite 2 Lv.1). Upgrade materials already spent will not be returned.
10 EPOQUE COLLECTION & 0011 YUN SERIES RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Curator for Reed the Flame Shadow
EPOQUE Collection - Private Study for Mint
0011 Yun Series - Away From Dust for Jieyun
OTHERS:
What the Firelight Casts available in [Side Story]
Starts at: June 27, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
FURNITURE: Reed's Cabin (Pieces)
DURATION: Available from June 27, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow available in [Side Story]
Starts at: July 3, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
FURNITURE: Yumen Clinic (Pieces)
DURATION: Available from July 3, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
Please stay tuned for more information!
